en.content: On complete combustion 0.30 g of an organic compound gave 0.20 g of carbon dioxide and 0.10 g of water. The percentage of carbon in the given organic compound is _____________. (Nearest integer)
en.explanation:
Given organic compound CxHy= 0.3 gm

Produced carbon dioxide (CO2) = 0.2 gm

Produced water (H2O) = 0.1 gm

Moles of CO2 =

Moles of C atom =

Mass of C atom = 12 = 0.0545

Moles of H2O =

Moles of H atoms = 2

Mass of H atoms = 1 = 0.0111

% of C atom = 100 = 18%
